label: legal specialist in field
definition: Person X is explicitly identified as a legal expert or lawyer specializing in legal field or issue Y.
scope_notes: Includes: lawyer specializing in Y; explicit legal expert, authority, or specialist on Y; a legal-field modifier of a lawyer. Excludes: client representation without specialization; generic institutional membership; practice location or ordinary employment; expertise in a nonlegal field. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear legal field versus client; lawyer title or field attachment unresolved. Y is a legal subject, not the represented client. Expertise is textual attribution, not an independent credential evaluation.

facts.reason: Floyd Abrams → First Amendment: Explicit specialist/expert or lawyer-specializing-in wording identifies expertise in First Amendment law.

review.method: Explicit manual judgment after reading the full relation dictionary and every supplied case row; citations include the complete considered evidence.

facts.reason: Richard → Manhattan: A city-modified lawyer or opening a location does not establish specialization in a legal field.
